[0] Hecrim has lots of sustain with your W.
[0] Hecrim's hard countered by heavy CC, especially point-and-click CC.

[0] Your E is only going to be used to make ganks happen early game because you always want to have it up for a gank. Otherwise, your ganks are pretty pointless.

[0] although Hecrim is one of the best snowballing champions and he's one of the best like um like carry champions, he falls off later into the game relative to some junglers and mainly to like range champs
[1] However, he is reliant on his team to follow up his engage and is very all in with few options to get out.
[1] Each stack makes the next Q deal bonus damage and also reduces the cool down of it by a good chunk.

[1] While active, Hecarim gains bonus armor and magic resist and is healed for a good chunk of the damage dealt to enemies and a smaller chunk of the damage dealt to allies as long as they're within the circle.
[1] However, he only travels to the circle and also fears all enemies within that circle.
[1] Your ganks are very straightforward where you simply want to use E, run behind your enemy, and hit them in the wrong direction while using W and spamming Q's and attacks.
